provider.readme:
# Claude — Anthropic
Anthropic's flagship chat web UI at [claude.ai](https://claude.ai). The bridge drives the logged-in browser session — your existing Pro/Team subscription is the rate limiter, no per-token API fees.
**Models typically exposed** (subject to discovery on first login):
- Claude Opus 4.7 — flagship reasoning - Claude Sonnet 4.6 — balanced default - Claude Haiku 4 — fast tier
Core provider — preinstalled and required for the extension to ship a working out-of-box experience. Cannot be uninstalled from the provider marketplace.
